cases.fault: Kill one primary server while a worker has already Pulled but not Pushed
cases.observed_on_pass: Survivors promoted and training resumed; final fixed-gradient weights matched the independent offline oracle
cases.guarantee: Exactly-once effects for all recorded acknowledged logical Pushes under one confirmed crash-stop failure
cases.limit: Single failed server, live manager, k=1, and no concurrent network partition

cases.fault: Kill source server after staging its E1 transfer
cases.observed_on_pass: Unpublished destination data was discarded, old source partition promoted, old Task IDs deduplicated, and replication repaired
cases.guarantee: Prepublication single-source crash rolls back staging without losing acknowledged state
cases.limit: Migration globally write-fenced; this is not a fully online E1 transfer

cases.fault: Kill destination server after transfer staging
cases.observed_on_pass: Old source range remained authoritative; failed destination's own range was promoted and writes resumed
cases.guarantee: Prepublication destination loss does not publish speculative transfer state
cases.limit: Only one server crash; staging protocol requires surviving replicas

cases.fault: Kill source after publishing a partial range migration
cases.observed_on_pass: Migration repair refused to release write fences; ownership epoch was not republished
cases.guarantee: Safety by rejecting writes while retained subranges cannot be reconstructed; NOT availability
cases.limit: Partial postpublication source crash is NOT recovered; training can remain blocked

cases.fault: Kill real worker subprocess while another is blocked under bounded delay tau=1
cases.observed_on_pass: Manager excluded dead worker; surviving worker resumed and exactly three acknowledged gradients determined final weights
cases.guarantee: Timed-out worker cannot stall bounded-delay gate indefinitely; historical progress retained
cases.limit: No per-worker fencing at the parameter-server Push layer for late in-flight requests

cases.fault: Delay an actual Push RPC before forwarding to the real primary
cases.observed_on_pass: Both Pushes acknowledged, applied once and replicated in sequence
cases.guarantee: Finite client-to-server request delay changes latency but not Push or backup state
cases.limit: Test shim creates a controlled delay, not arbitrary network reordering

cases.fault: Drop first Push before network forwarding; retry unchanged Task ID
cases.observed_on_pass: First attempt produced no update; successful replay applied and replicated once
cases.guarantee: One dropped request followed by a Task-ID-preserving retry does not double-apply
cases.limit: One-shot test-only drop; not indefinite link partition or uncontrolled loss rate

cases.fault: Deliver Push and let primary+backup commit, then discard client-visible ACK
cases.observed_on_pass: Replayed identical Task ID returned accepted without another update on primary or replica
cases.guarantee: ACK loss after committed Push is idempotent under retry of identical Task ID
cases.limit: Retry must preserve Task ID and identical request payload

cases.observed_on_pass: Unpublished migration aborted without changing epoch; subsequent acknowledged Push replicated once
cases.guarantee: Missing staging RPC cannot expose an incomplete new ownership epoch
cases.limit: Manager and original source remain available
